what: Cursors that look like others co-viewing in a design tool — a black arrow and an accent-color name tag glide with ease-in-out to random spots inside the card. It rests a random 1~3 seconds before the next departure, and the travel time is also random between .25s and that rest, so it drifts slowly and then darts. The first step comes 1 second after attaching

options.size: Size to clear from the panel edge (px), default 20
options.[data-fx-part=tag]: (If present) takes the accent-color label shape

use: Your Name

from.where: index.html .mp-canvas — name-tag cursor in the ”Web Design” cell
